slides.title: Use peaceful dialogue and diplomatic channels
slides.body: The AU asked Ethiopia, Eritrea and Egypt to keep communication open.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Allow humanitarian access. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

card.title: AU urges Ethiopia, Eritrea and Egypt to show "maximum restraint"
card.body: African Union Commission statement, Oct 1, 2026. It offered to support de-escalation and peaceful dialogue.
